types.name: system.v1.AffectedService
types.doc: AffectedService is a part of the platform a status event affects.

values.name: TRADING
values.doc: Placing, changing and cancelling orders, and order execution.

values.name: MARKET_DATA
values.doc: Prices, trades, candles and order books.

values.name: ACCOUNTS
values.doc: Sign-in, account management and API keys.

values.name: API
values.doc:
The REST and WebSocket interfaces for programmatic clients such as market
 makers and brokers.

types.name: system.v1.GetVersionResponse
types.doc: GetVersionResponse identifies the exact build the environment serves.

fields.name: version
fields.doc:
Version of the exact build. A release reports its version in
 MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH form, such as "0.10.0". A build made after a release
 appends the number of source revisions since that release and "g" with
 the first 12 hexadecimal digits of its own revision, such as
 "0.10.0-12-g4e21a2f09670": 12 revisions after release 0.10.0. Releases
 before mainnet are 0.MINOR.PATCH; mainnet starts at 1.0.0.

fields.name: commit
fields.doc: Full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal source revision of the build.

fields.name: environment
fields.doc:
Environment that answered: "devnet", "testnet" or "mainnet", or "local"
 for a development stack.

types.name: system.v1.ListStatusEventsRequest
types.doc:
ListStatusEventsRequest selects status events. Filters on different fields
 combine with AND; values within one field combine with OR.

fields.name: states
fields.doc:
States to include. Empty means SCHEDULED and IN_PROGRESS: current and
 upcoming events.

fields.name: kinds
fields.doc: Kinds to include. Empty means all.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum events to return. 0 means the default of 50; maximum 200.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed, exclusive cursor from a previous response. Bound
 to states and kinds, and to the start time and id of the last event
 returned. Reuse it only with the same states and kinds. States follow
 the clock, so an event that changes state between two pages can be
 missing from both or appear on both; match events by id.

fields.name: events
fields.doc:
Matching events ordered by start_time descending, then id descending:
 the latest start first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: system.v1.StatusEvent
types.doc: StatusEvent is one scheduled maintenance or incident.

fields.name: id
fields.doc:
Stable opaque 64-bit identifier. It never changes when the event is
 updated.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Maintenance or incident.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: State at the time of the response.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Short title, at most 200 characters.

fields.name: message
fields.doc:
Plain-text summary for users, at most 4000 characters. It can be revised;
 progress notes are in updates.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc:
Start of the window: when the maintenance begins, or when the incident
 began. It no longer changes once the window has started.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
End of the window, after start_time: when the maintenance is expected to
 end, or when the incident ended or is expected to end. Always set for
 MAINTENANCE. Omitted for an INCIDENT with no expected end yet.

fields.name: services
fields.doc: Affected parts of the platform. Never empty.

fields.name: markets
fields.doc:
Symbols of the affected markets, such as "BTC-USDT", in ascending order.
 Empty when the event is not limited to particular markets.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc:
Time of the latest change to the event, a new progress note included. Its
 state moving with the clock is not a change.

fields.name: impact
fields.doc:
Severity of an INCIDENT. IMPACT_UNSPECIFIED for MAINTENANCE and for an
 incident not yet assessed.

fields.name: assets
fields.doc:
Codes of the affected assets, such as "SOL", in ascending order. Empty
 when the event is not limited to particular assets.

fields.name: cancelled_at
fields.doc: When the event was cancelled. Set only when state is CANCELLED.

fields.name: updates
fields.doc: Progress notes, oldest first. At most 50.

fields.name: details_url
fields.doc:
HTTPS link to a long-form announcement about the event, at most 2048
 characters. Omitted when the event has none.

types.name: system.v1.StatusEventImpact
types.doc: StatusEventImpact is how severely an incident affects users.

values.name: DEGRADED
values.doc: Working, but slower or less reliable than usual.

values.name: PARTIAL_OUTAGE
values.doc: Unavailable for some users, markets or assets.

values.name: MAINTENANCE
values.doc: Planned maintenance, announced ahead of its window.

types.name: system.v1.StatusEventState
types.doc:
StatusEventState is where a status event stands at the time of the
 response. It follows from the event's window: SCHEDULED before start_time,
 IN_PROGRESS from start_time until end_time, and COMPLETED from end_time on.
 A cancelled event is CANCELLED whatever its window.

values.name: IN_PROGRESS
values.doc: The window has started and not ended.

values.name: CANCELLED
values.doc: Called off; its window no longer applies.

types.name: system.v1.StatusEventUpdate
types.doc:
StatusEventUpdate is one progress note posted on a status event. Notes are
 never edited or removed.

fields.name: id
fields.doc:
Position of the note on its event: 1 for the first, then increasing by 1.
 Unique within the event and never reused.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Plain-text note for users, at most 4000 characters.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the note was posted.
